mapper.select: SELECT idt.serial_number as ticketCode, '入库工单' as type, idt.owner_unit as unit, idt.warehouse as warehouse, idt.device_num as number, idt.create_time as tim, idt.`status` as `status`, idt.receiver as user FROM `idevelop_device_storage` idt left join idevelop_device_storage_list idtl on idt.id = idtl.storage_id where idtl.device_code = #{deviceCode}
SELECT * FROM `idevelop_device_apply` ida left join idevelop_device_apply_detail idad on ida.id = idad.apply_id where idad.old_device_code = #{deviceCode}
SELECT * FROM `idevelop_device_operation` ido left join idevelop_device_operation_detail idod on ido.id = idod.operation_id where idod.device_code = #{deviceCode}
SELECT * FROM `idevelop_device_change` idc left join idevelop_device_change_list idcl on idc.id = idcl.change_id where idcl.device_code = #{deviceCode}
SELECT * FROM `idevelop_device_repair` idr left join idevelop_device_repair_list idrl on idr.id = idrl.repair_id where idrl.device_code = #{deviceCode}
